# Distance-3 color code memory in the XYZ cycling style. Data qubits 0..6 sit on the
# Steane layout with faces {0,1,2,3}, {1,2,4,5}, {2,3,5,6}. Every round applies C_XYZ to
# the data before the MPP stabilizer measurements, so the face products cycle
# X -> Y -> Z and each detector compares the record that the cycled stabilizer predicts.
# With records x (X face) and z (Z face), a round measures x' = z and z' = x + z.
QUBIT_COORDS(0, 0) 0
QUBIT_COORDS(1, 0) 1
QUBIT_COORDS(2, 0) 2
QUBIT_COORDS(3, 0) 3
QUBIT_COORDS(1, 1) 4
QUBIT_COORDS(2, 1) 5
QUBIT_COORDS(3, 1) 6
RX 0 1 2 3 4 5 6
TICK
MPP X0*X1*X2*X3 X1*X2*X4*X5 X2*X3*X5*X6
MPP Z0*Z1*Z2*Z3 Z1*Z2*Z4*Z5 Z2*Z3*Z5*Z6
DETECTOR(0, 0, 0) rec[-6]
DETECTOR(1, 0, 0) rec[-5]
DETECTOR(2, 0, 0) rec[-4]
REPEAT 2 {
    TICK
    C_XYZ 0 1 2 3 4 5 6
    DEPOLARIZE1(0.001) 0 1 2 3 4 5 6
    MPP X0*X1*X2*X3 X1*X2*X4*X5 X2*X3*X5*X6
    MPP Z0*Z1*Z2*Z3 Z1*Z2*Z4*Z5 Z2*Z3*Z5*Z6
    SHIFT_COORDS(0, 0, 1)
    DETECTOR(0, 0, 0) rec[-6] rec[-9]
    DETECTOR(1, 0, 0) rec[-5] rec[-8]
    DETECTOR(2, 0, 0) rec[-4] rec[-7]
    DETECTOR(0, 1, 0) rec[-3] rec[-12] rec[-9]
    DETECTOR(1, 1, 0) rec[-2] rec[-11] rec[-8]
    DETECTOR(2, 1, 0) rec[-1] rec[-10] rec[-7]
}
TICK
M 0 1 2 3 4 5 6
DETECTOR(0, 2, 0) rec[-7] rec[-6] rec[-5] rec[-4] rec[-10]
DETECTOR(1, 2, 0) rec[-6] rec[-5] rec[-3] rec[-2] rec[-9]
DETECTOR(2, 2, 0) rec[-5] rec[-4] rec[-2] rec[-1] rec[-8]
OBSERVABLE_INCLUDE(0) rec[-7] rec[-6] rec[-5] rec[-4] rec[-3] rec[-2] rec[-1]
